description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These parts fix the shifting problems with both shifters:
The Sheet Shifters go inside the Transfer Case & Transmission Shifter Housings and sit under the Shift Levers.
Both are easy to remove and reinstall with an average total time of about 30 minutes.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Sheet Shift (Transmission)
Qty 1 – Sheet Shift (T-Case)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
